 How to Play GTA 6 Early on XBOX With New Zealand Trick—All Time Zones, Explained
 Grand Theft Auto 6 is a generational video game with an aura that is unparalleled. It has the gaming world in an iron grip right now, and it’s set to be the fastest-selling, most record-breaking game of all time. It drops on November 19th, but there’s a trick you can do to ensure you can play it as early as possible .
 If you’re trying to figure out how to do the New Zealand trick on XBOX to play GTA 6 early, you need to look no further than this guide . I’ve broken down the simple steps to follow to unlock GTA 6 early on XBOX with this account trick, and it only takes around 30 seconds to complete the guide.
 Scroll down!
 How to Play GTA 6 Early on XBOX
 If you’re a PlayStation gamer, you need to head to the other guide that details how to do the New Zealand trick on PS5 . Heads up: it’s a lot tougher than doing it on XBOX, that’s for sure.
 But if you have an XBOX Series X or XBOX Series S console and you want to buy GTA 6 and play it early via the New Zealand method, you’re in the right place.
 Here are the steps required to play GTA 6 early on XBOX:
 Switch on your console and log in to your account
 Head to the settings menu
 Click System and then Language & Localization
 Change your Location to New Zealand
 Restart your console
 That’s it – XBOX now thinks you live on the other side of the world
 That’s all you need to do. But in case you’re confused about timings , I’ve got you covered there as well…
 GTA 6 Launch Times for New Zealand Trick
 Here’s a helpful table that explains when the New Zealand trick will work on XBOX in your country:
 Timezone Time GTA 6 Goes Live 
 New Zealand (NZDT) 00:00 (November 19) 
 United Kingdom (GMT) 11:00 (November 18) 
 East Coast (EST) 06:00 (November 18) 
 West Coast (PST) 03:00 (November 18) 
 Central Europe (CET) 12:00 (November 18) 
 Japan (JST) 20:00 (November 18) 
 India (IST) 16:30 (November 18) 
 Central (CST) 05:00 (November 18)
